rest_api.title: Opus GreenNet Bridge (REST API)
rest_api.description: Enter the address of the gateway's REST API. Setup reads only the gateway's identity; no EnOcean device is queried.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the OPUS gateway in your network.
data_description.port: Port of the gateway's REST API (default 8080).
data_description.username: User name of the gateway's REST API (vendor default: admin).
data_description.password: Password of the gateway's REST API. The vendor default is the gateway's EURID in capital letters.

confirm.title: Update references to {removed_entity_id}
confirm.description:
While adopting the upstream unique IDs, the integration found two registry entries for the same device and gateway. It kept your existing entity {preserved_entity_id} with its entity ID, name and settings, and removed the duplicate entity {removed_entity_id}.

Automations, scripts, scenes and dashboards that still use {removed_entity_id} no longer work. Replace that entity ID with {preserved_entity_id}, then select Submit to dismiss this message. Nothing is sent to the gateway or the device.
